summary: Reinitializes the session's internal sub-objects. If the initialized flag at this+0x0 is already set, returns 4 without touching anything. Otherwise cleans up the existing batch at this+0x4 via BatchLoopWithMemoryCleanup, allocates a new 0x18-byte inner-buffer struct via Malloc0x18ByteStructWithInnerBuffer(sub_5640F0), frees the existing audio array at this+0x94 via DestroyAudioArrayFreeElementsThenContainer, allocates a fresh typed array via AllocateIntArrayViaFactory(4, sub_5645A0, IndirectDwordCompare, sub_564630), resets this+0x98 to 0, and returns 0. Called by StartNetworkUpdate (0x00461DE0).

operations.description: Guard: if the initialized flag at this+0x0 is non-zero, return 4 immediately (already-initialized early exit).
Call BatchLoopWithMemoryCleanup on the existing batch pointer stored at this+0x4 to tear down its sub-objects before replacement.
Call Malloc0x18ByteStructWithInnerBuffer(sub_5640F0) to allocate the new 0x18-byte sub-struct; sub_5640F0 is the callback that builds its inner buffer.
Store the newly allocated sub-struct into the batch slot at this+0x4.
Call DestroyAudioArrayFreeElementsThenContainer on the old audio-array pointer at this+0x94 to free its elements and container.

Call AllocateIntArrayViaFactory(4, sub_5645A0, IndirectDwordCompare, sub_564630): allocates a typed array with element count 4, element factory sub_5645A0, comparison callback IndirectDwordCompare, and management callback sub_564630.
Store the newly allocated typed array into the audio-array slot at this+0x94.
Reset the counter at this+0x98 to 0.
Return 0 on success (4 on the already-initialized early exit).
Called by StartNetworkUpdate (0x00461DE0) during session/sub-object reinitialization.
